subject.title: Disable Chrome OptGuide/WasmTts model downloads in headless/server mode

question: Should OpenClaw add OptimizationGuide/WasmTts disabled-feature flags by default for managed and sandbox headless Chrome launches, or keep this as an operator-controlled `browser.extraArgs`/custom-entrypoint workaround?
rationale: The code change is small, but default browser launch behavior affects all managed/server Chrome users and the current workaround already exists for local managed profiles; maintainer intent is needed before changing defaults or adding config surface.

options.title: Prove, then add headless defaults
options.body: Run live current-Chrome proof and, if it confirms the waste, add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

options.title: Document operator control only
options.body: Keep built-in launch defaults unchanged and document `browser.extraArgs` for local managed profiles plus custom sandbox entrypoints as the supported server-mode mitigation.

options.title: Add an explicit config knob
options.body: Introduce a dedicated model-download suppression option only if maintainers decide the existing `browser.extraArgs` surface is insufficient despite the config-surface bar.

recommendation.title: Prove, then add headless defaults
recommendation.body: Run live current-Chrome proof and, if it confirms the waste, add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest browser-launch history and already reviewed the related stale implementation PR into the current browser-plugin boundary.
